summary: Frontend-only testing of redesigned admin 'Kategori Yönetimi' card grid. All 7 active category cards render with pastel colors and 8 'Yakında' preview cards render. Clicking each active card correctly switches the AdminPanel to its manager tab (Duyurular→announcements w/ add-announcement-btn, Pulse→pulse tab active, Etkinlikler→events w/ add-event-btn, Günlük Mod→mood, İlanlar→listings, Avatar Seçimi→avatar, Servis Güzergahı→routes w/ add-route-btn). Clicking a 'Yakında' card (cat-future-isg) does NOT navigate and shows an info toast 'İSG · yakında eklenecek'. Hover icons stopPropagation correctly: cat-edit opens category dialog (cat-name-input visible), cat-subs toggles cat-subpanel-<id>, cat-del + cat-del-confirm deletes the category (verified via GET /api/categories). Drag-and-drop reorder works and persists to backend (order[0]↔order[3] swap confirmed via GET /api/categories, then restored). Regression: add-category-btn still opens create dialog. Regression: employee /ic-iletisim still renders 7 comms-card-<id> items.
critical_code_review_comments: CategoriesManager.js (338 lines) is approaching the split-threshold; CategoryDialog and SubcategoryPanel could be extracted into their own files for maintainability.
Unused imports in CategoriesManager.js: GripVertical, ChevronRight, DialogTrigger — safe to remove.
seed_data_creation: Temporarily created and deleted a TEST_DEL_CAT category during delete-flow test; no residual data. Reorder was performed and restored to original order.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Admin card grid feature works end-to-end. Card→tab mapping: duyuru→announcements, pulse→pulse, etkinlik→events, gunluk_mod→mood, ilan→listings, avatar→avatar, servis→routes. For DnD testing use page.drag_and_drop(src, tgt); synthetic DragEvent dispatch does not fire React handlers reliably. Note: api.reorderCategories sends {ordered_ids: [...]}, NOT {ids: [...]} — the backend returns 422 if you use 'ids'.
